name: completed_orders
sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, ordered_at FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed'

name: items_joined
sql: SELECT o.order_id, oi.order_item_id, oi.quantity * oi.unit_price AS line_amount FROM orders AS o INNER JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed'

name: customers_joined
sql: SELECT o.order_id, oi.order_item_id, c.region, oi.quantity * oi.unit_price AS line_amount FROM orders AS o INNER JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id INNER JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed'

name: refunds_joined
sql: SELECT o.order_id, oi.order_item_id, c.region, oi.quantity * oi.unit_price AS line_amount FROM orders AS o INNER JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id INNER JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed'
